abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only one YouTube-DLP configuration is supported.

error.cannot_create_folder: The download folder cannot be created or is not writable.

user.title: YouTube-DLP
user.description: Choose the folder where finished audio/video files will be stored.

data_description.file_path: Absolute path where completed audio/video files are stored.
data_description.media_library_path: Folder scanned for local audio playback. Leave empty during initial setup to use the download folder.

download.name: Download media
download.description: Starts a YouTube/yt-dlp download in the background and stores only the completed media file in the configured folder.

media_type.name: Media type
media_type.description: Download video or extract audio only.

video_quality.name: Video quality
video_quality.description: Maximum video height, or best available.

audio_quality.name: Audio quality
audio_quality.description: Requested audio bitrate in kbps, or best.

wait_for_completion.name: Wait for completion
wait_for_completion.description: Keep the action running until download and post-processing finish. Home Assistant remains responsive because the work runs in the executor.

search.name: Search YouTube
search.description: Searches YouTube and returns metadata for matching videos.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Song, artist, or other YouTube search text.

play.name: Play YouTube on target
play.description: Chooses the playback method from the configured target type: audio for speakers, DLNA-compatible audio for DLNA, and video for TVs.

url.name: URL
url.description: YouTube or other yt-dlp-supported HTTP(S) media URL.

media_player.name: Speaker
media_player.description: Home Assistant media player that will play the resolved audio stream.

scan_library.name: Scan music library
scan_library.description: Returns supported audio files from the configured music library folder. The scan runs outside the Home Assistant event loop and is cached briefly.

force.name: Force rescan
force.description: Ignore the short library cache and scan the folder again now.

favorites_list.name: List online favorites
favorites_list.description: Returns the persistent list of saved online YouTube links used by the bundled dashboard card.

favorites_add.name: Add online favorite
favorites_add.description: Resolves YouTube metadata once and stores the stable link and display metadata in Home Assistant storage.

url.name: URL
url.description: YouTube or other yt-dlp-supported HTTP(S) media URL to save.

favorites_remove.name: Remove online favorite
favorites_remove.description: Removes one saved online favorite by URL.

get_media_targets.name: Get playback targets
get_media_targets.description: Returns the speakers, DLNA renderers and TVs selected in the integration options.

favorites_playback_play_position.name: Play favorite by position
favorites_playback_play_position.description: Play a saved Online favorite or an Offline library track by 1-based position. Order matches the card: Online newest saved first, Offline newest file first. Useful in any automation without a manual queue.

kind.name: Favorites category
kind.description: Online saved YouTube favorites or Offline library tracks.

position.name: Song position (starting at 1)
position.description: Position in the full corresponding Favorites tab, counting from 1. For example, 3 plays the third item.

media_players.name: Media players
media_players.description: One or more Home Assistant media players for playback.

play_mode.name: Playback mode
play_mode.description: Single: play only this song. Continue: start at this song and then play the remaining favorites in their displayed order.

repeat_mode.name: Repeat mode
repeat_mode.description: Off: stop at the end. One: repeat the current song. All: repeat the queue (Continue mode loops back to the first favorite).

replace_selection.name: Replace checked favorites
replace_selection.description: When enabled, replace the dashboard's selected favorites and repeat setting with this queue. Off by default to preserve the dashboard selection.

favorites_playback_start.name: Start favorites queue
favorites_playback_start.description: Start an explicit list of saved favorite URLs (Online) or library file IDs (Offline) in the specified order; typically invoked by the dashboard card.

queue.name: Queue
queue.description: Ordered URL list (Online) or file ID list (Offline). Use Play favorite by position instead if you want to select a numbered song.

kind.name: Favorites type
kind.description: Online (saved URLs) or Offline (library file IDs).

media_players.name: Media players
media_players.description: One or more Home Assistant media player entities.

repeat_mode.name: Repeat mode
repeat_mode.description: Off, repeat current song, or repeat the complete queue.

replace_selection.name: Replace selected favorites
replace_selection.description: Whether to replace saved checkbox selection with the supplied queue.

download_video.name: Download video
download_video.description: Download a video with video-only settings.

url.name: Media URL
url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the media to play or download.

wait_for_completion.name: Wait for completion
wait_for_completion.description: Wait for the download job to finish before this action returns.

url.name: Media URL
url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the media to play or download.

wait_for_completion.name: Wait for completion
wait_for_completion.description: Wait for the download job to finish before this action returns.

get_job.name: Get download job
get_job.description: Get progress and result details for a download job by ID.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: Identifier returned by a download action.

play_multi.name: Play YouTube on multiple players
play_multi.description: Play a media URL on one or more media player entities.

url.name: Media URL
url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the media to play or download.

media_players.name: Media players
media_players.description: One or more Home Assistant media player entities.

favorites_playback_get.name: Get favorites playback state
favorites_playback_get.description: Return the saved selections, repeat settings and active playback queue.

favorites_playback_set.name: Set favorites playback selections
favorites_playback_set.description: Save selected favorite identifiers and repeat mode for the media card.

online_selected.name: Selected Online favorites
online_selected.description: List of saved Online favorite URLs to check in the card.

offline_selected.name: Selected Offline favorites
offline_selected.description: List of Offline library file IDs to check in the card.

repeat_mode.name: Repeat mode
repeat_mode.description: Off, repeat current song, or repeat the complete queue.

favorites_playback_skip.name: Skip favorites playback
favorites_playback_skip.description: Jump to the previous, next or current song of an active favorites queue.

direction.name: Skip direction
direction.description: Previous song, next song, or replay current song.

favorites_playback_stop.name: Stop favorites playback
favorites_playback_stop.description: Stop the active favorites queue and clear selections.

play_targets.name: Play media on configured targets
play_targets.description: Play a media URL on multiple media players, using their configured target types.

url.name: Media URL
url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the media to play or download.

media_players.name: Media players
media_players.description: One or more Home Assistant media player entities.

favorites_playback_play_random.name: Play one random favorite
favorites_playback_play_random.description: Each invocation randomly picks one track from all Online favorites or Offline library files. No queue, position, or checked selection is needed.

kind.name: Favorites type
kind.description: Online saved URLs or Offline library tracks.

media_players.name: Media players
media_players.description: One or more Home Assistant media players.

repeat_mode.name: Repeat mode
repeat_mode.description: Off (default) plays one track and stops; one/all repeats the selected track.

replace_selection.name: Replace checked favorites
replace_selection.description: Off by default: preserve the checked favorites in the card.

not_configured.message: YouTube-DLP is not configured or its configuration entry is not loaded.

ffmpeg_missing.message: FFmpeg was not found. Home Assistant OS and Container include it; Home Assistant Core installations must install FFmpeg on the host.

download_path_unavailable.message: The configured download folder is unavailable or not writable: {error}

favorite_position_invalid.message: Requested favorite position {position} is not available; there are {count} items.

favorite_random_empty.message: There are no {kind} favorites available for random playback.

settings.title: Folders and notifications
settings.description: Manage download/library folders and notifications. Only folder changes reload the integration.

folders.name: Media folders
folders.description: Configure where downloads are stored and which folder the dashboard media library scans.

data_description.file_path: Absolute writable path where completed audio/video files are stored.
data_description.media_library_path: Folder scanned for local audio playback. It can be the same as the download folder.

add_media_target.title: Add speaker or TV
add_media_target.description: Choose a media player already known to Home Assistant.

media_target_details.title: Target name and type
media_target_details.description: Entity: {entity_id}. This classification determines the playback method.
